note: Adapted from the species description of Acholotermes tithasus by Sands (1972), originally in English; the species has no soldier, and only the alate and the worker are described; the original comparisons for this species point only to the accounts of other species, and no separate diagnostic section was established. Measurement-table headings, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated, and some measurement values corrupted by OCR in the tables are omitted.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and pilosity yellow. Postclypeus moderately inflated, Pcl/W 0.28. Mandibular apical teeth very long, ratio of left apical to first marginal tooth 1.07, right mandible 1.29; left accessory marginal tooth just free of the molar prominence in surface view, composite ratio 22.55; anterior margin of first marginal tooth of right mandible shorter than that of second marginal tooth, composite ratio 30.15. Fore tibia moderately inflated, T1/Tw 3.92, third apical spur about two thirds the length of the other two spurs. Midgut and hindgut meet transversely, to the right of the Malpighian node; valve seat lateral or slightly dorsolateral in the undissected abdomen; internal cushions of the valve moderately developed, surface scaly, posterior margin of each scale ornamented with several small spines; membranous wall of the valve beyond the cushions with numerous fine, distinct spines arranged in 15–20 rows, only slightly interrupted between the posterior ends of the cushions into fringed lobes. The worker abdomen appears to be of the weakly dehiscent type.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, darker above the ocelli; fontanelle small, circular, flat, less than one fifth the size of an ocellus, pale brown; middle spot twice the size of the fontanelle, flat, concolorous with the head capsule; postclypeus dark brown, labrum yellowish brown; frontal mark a flat crescent, concolorous with the head capsule; antennae brown. Pronotum dark brown, meso- and metanotum brown, mesonotum without a transverse suture, metanotum with a weak transverse suture; femora and tibiae pale yellowish brown, tarsi yellow. Abdominal tergites brown, dorsolateral spiracles paler, sternites yellowish brown laterally with paler ventrolateral spiracles and a yellow middle; cerci yellow. Posterior margin of head capsule slightly arched, not evenly rounded; ocelli rather small, separated from the compound eye by slightly more than their own minimum diameter; postclypeus weakly inflated, Pcl/W 0.23, posterior margin nearly obtuse-angled and not evenly rounded, median suture weak. Mandibular apical teeth very long, ratio of apical to first marginal tooth 0.91–1.04 on the left, 1.33–1.45 on the right; left accessory marginal tooth level with the edge of the molar prominence in surface view, composite ratio 13.50–16.29; first marginal tooth of right mandible inserted slightly behind the line from the apical to the second marginal tooth, anterior margins of first and second marginal teeth equal. Head capsule pilosity uneven, not forming a felt. Meso- and metanotum rather broad at the constriction, M/W 0.30–0.32. Third apical spur of fore tibia almost as long as the other two spurs.
